title: Top 5 FASTEST Things In The Universe
hook: Number one crosses your entire room a billion times per second.

items.name: Voyager 1 Spacecraft
items.stat: Travels at about 61,000 km/h relative to the Sun, the fastest human-made object leaving the solar system.

items.name: Parker Solar Probe
items.stat: Hit about 692,000 km/h near the Sun, the fastest human-made object ever built.

items.name: Pulsar PSR J0952-0607
items.stat: Spins 707 times every single second, its surface whipping around at a fraction of light speed.

items.name: Blazar Relativistic Jets
items.stat: Blast plasma outward at over 99.9% the speed of light across thousands of light-years.

items.name: Light (Photons)
items.stat: Travels at exactly 299,792,458 meters per second, the ultimate cosmic speed limit nothing can beat.
